nom: IT Cosmetics Bye Bye Lines Hyaluronic Acid Serum

avis.texte: I tried it for 2 months along with the one for pores. Didn't see any improvement. It just made my skin feel like it had a mask on it.

I used the entire bottle so I feel like I can confidently review this. I don't like heavy creams so this was great. Very light, absorbed right in, no residue feeling. In a pinch, I'd use this alone and it worked at giving me just enough moisture. But after an entire bottle, I can't really tell a difference. Maybe my lines didn't get worse, to be fair. But I'll move on and try something else now.

I really like this serum, I was using olay serum but thought I try this, I have some fine lines on my forehead and around my eyes. this really pumps my skin up and I'm on my second bottle which is good for me, I usually move on to something else.

It doesnt take a lot to impress me with skincare and this was nothing special at all. I always finish my bottles and i ended up leaving the ens of it and moving on to something new. It wasnt particularly hydrating which was the whole point and i wasnt a fan of the texture. I dont expect miracles when using a serum for a month or so but this did me no favors. I didnt get a glow from hydration or anything

I was pleased that it soaked in skin right away & there was never a trace of residue.I am almost to the end of 1st bottle but don't plan to purchase 2nd bottle.

Does absolutely nothing but leave a strange fillm on your face and if you try to put there anti aging moisturizer over it yikes 😳, you just have a sticky mess on your face , ive used there products in the past but in recent years something has changed or gone wrong, I returned it

I love this serum and Dimes H.A. Serum. Apply to pretty wet skin, i use an old spray bottle to wet face first in the morning then apply this and while still damp my clinique yellow lotion ( dramatically different lotion) and it wears wonderfully under my tinted moisturizer and it cosmetics serum concealer. Im 40 dry skin, average wrinkles for someone with no injections…yet.
I've been using 1x a day for a week and I can already tell my lines are fading
Only downside I've noticed is that my foundation looks a little cakey at the end of the day if i use it in the morning, before i apply makeup.

I am 40 years old and have used almost every brand of skincare products. I usually use Alsatian which is the only skincare line that rebuilds collagen. I ran out of it and decided to try this since I use itcosmetics cc cream. I immediately saw results. It cleared up hormonal acne and my skin is perfectly hydrated. If you're on the fence about trying this product, go for it. You won't regret it. I do use the moisturizer made by itcosmetics with it. I would recommend both
Help me to get rid of my fines lines, everytime is on sell a get a few
I have bought this product several times and love how light it feels on my skin!

Goes on easy, doesn't feel heavy on skin! Lines less visible especially around eyes.
I absolutely love this product. I use it daily and I love the results that I see.

I decided to try this product for my smile lines after seeing it had good reviews, and let me tell you it works great i instantly saw a difference within a week my lines are hardly there my makeup doesnt crease anymore am so happy with that i found this product.

Tried this along with the Serum for Dark Spots, No matter what I put on moisturize even any of theirs its a sloppy mess. If I dare try and put make up on it pills horrible! Very sticky. I am using not even the amount they recommend. Very disappointed.
Love this serum my skin looks brighter and more plump more hydrated. I use it in combination with the confidence cream and night cream. It feels good on my rosacea skin it doesn't irritate it at all.
Using this daily has made a significant difference in the appearance of facial lines. I love this! Thanks, IT!
This is my go-to for reducing the appearance of fine line around my eyes and neck creases.

Love this serum! So Hydrating. Absorbs quickly. Minimise wrinkles.
I have used this product for years and wouldn't change. Wonderful results.
Really helps with fine lines and wrinkles. Use every other day
Works as advertised, love how it doesn't "pill" under makeup as some serums do.
I've used this product for several years and my skin has fewer wrinkles than women my age.
I like this hyaluronic acid serum with peptide. It seems to be of good quality

Smooth application and my skin looks so good the next morning

avis.titre: Help keep my fine lines away
avis.texte: I love that this serum is effective yet doesn't burn or dry out your skin. It absorbs quickly and is very effective at keeping my fine lines at bay.
I have been using this for 2 months. I have noticed a significant reduction in the fine line around my eyes. I was considering botox for this area, but I don't feel like I need that anymore!

avis.titre: Improved my skin in one bottle!
avis.texte: I am at the end of my first bottle and can see an improvement in my skin. My fine lines are much improved ! I'm hooked on this product and will continue to use it.
I absolutely love all IT cosmetics serums, I wear them everyday and after 4-6 weeks of consistent use I see and feel a major difference in my skin.

I am 55 years old and have been using It Cosmetics & skin care for 5+ years and I get SO MANY compliments on my skin. I have virtually no wrinkles, dark spots or saggy skin. I ALWAYS share this brand with people who compliment my skin.
After using continuously before bed I have noticed a dramatic improvement!
My sensitive skin could tolerate this serum. However, I am not sure if it was effective for its stated purpose.

avis.titre: The best fine line serum out there
avis.texte: I am obsessed with this product. I have been using it for about 6 months and my skin is smooth and soft and pores are barely noticeable. Fine lines are barely visible, even mellowed out my frown line.

This is not for individuals with sensitive skin. I used it for three days and it compltely damaged my skin barrier and caused irritation. Its been almost three weeks and the irritation is still there.
This product is amazing. Really changed the feel of skin and made my skin appear smoother.
This was my second bottle purchase. Works effectively on my lines, especially on the forehead I could tell a difference.
Omg this stuff really works. Use it nightly and nothing else around my eyes

avis.titre: Amazing Base to day and nighttime care
avis.texte: I use this product all over my face, eyelids and neck immediately after washing, and then apply my other serums and moisturizers. The feeling and smooth results are the best ever. I feel it makes every other product work better.

avis.titre: Goes on very smooth and a little goes a long way.
avis.texte: This has been one of my favorite hyaluronic acid serums out of the many I have tried. It goes on very nicely.
A must have, especially in winter! Keeps my skin nice and hydrated.
The Bye Bye Lines Serum feels great ok my skin. I'm Using it twice a day.
Not sure if it works and it's slightly irritating and uncomfortable.
I love this serum. I can actually feel it working (it tingles). Makes my skin feel hydrated. It's a must have for me!
Love this serum for its texture and smoothing effect on my skin. Plumps wrinkles for a smoother look.
I can not live with out this product, I use it every single morning and night. When I don't use it the texture of my make up is off. This is a must buy and to keep in your daily routine.
This is a great product. It works miracles I have been using it for a few months.
Ive liked every IT product ive used except this one. Wherever i apply it i break out, more like a reaction. Super sticky serum, and tacky when its drying. Not for me.

IT product are the best. The hypotonic acid Serums is hydrating for my dry skin. This is effective and works well. I don't feel any tightness and fine lines are slowly disappearing. This is essential for me and will always have it. I highly recommend
My skin has noticeably less fine lines especially around my eyes
I've used the product every day for the last month and I Couldn't tell any difference
I really like this Bye Bye Lines. None greasy!! I like that as well.
Great product, love the way it feels on my face, light and airly.
I love the Bye Bye lines serum!! I have such sensitive skin and I've tried other serums but they either broke me out or had zero results. I've recommended this product to all my friends and family!
I use this everyday and see a major difference in the appearance of my skin! It looks so much more supple.

avis.titre: Wanted to like it, for the price.
avis.texte: Smell didn't bother me. Has a slight gel feeling to it when you apply on skin. Made my skin break out bad. My skin still felt really dry with no improvements. Went back to old hyaluronic and my skin is back to being hydrated.
It's helping me to reduce the dryness of my skin because of the winter. Since the first time I used my skin felt and looked hydrated, soft. Not shiny at all. I have combined skin (oily and dry)

As someone with Rosacea, I am constantly looking for products that aid with the dryness of my skin while also calming the redness. This product has proven to be an excellent addition of moisture prior to my moisturizer and redness correcting product.

avis.titre: Deep lines to almost invisible lines
avis.texte: I LOVE this product! It took FOREVER to get it but once I got it I'm in love! In less than a week the lines on my face have virtually disappeared! It doesn't feel sticky at all either! I will definitely buy this product again!

This made my skin feel tight and dry immediately after applying and I didn't feel like it moisturized my skin at all. Other hyaluronic acid products I have used in the past I could tell they were hydrating and this one seemed to do the opposite. I used up almost half the bottle so i gave it a fair chance but no improvement so i will be tossing this and getting something better
Plump and hydrated skin. Can definitely tell the difference if I miss a day or two so I try not to!
I'm not a fan of the new formula for this. The lotion worked much better and left my skin looking, feeling better and softer to the touch. I'd much rather have the old bye bye lines back.
Made fabulous difference in my skin texture and wrinkle appearance.

I think this may be one of my top 3 IT products. I really feel like it does exactly what it says it will do. I have been using it consistently for about a year now and feel like my skin is better than it's ever been!

I have been using the Bye Bye Lines Hyaluronic Acid Serum for about 2 months now and I can see such an improvement in my skin. I get SOOOOO many compliments on my skin and so many questions of "what do you use?" I certainly rave about your IT product. I am 57 so lines are starting to set in. Well, the lines are not as prominent now. I will never stop using this product. My skin is getting better and better every single day.

I love this product! I use it daily as a part of my morning IT cosmetics skincare and makeup routine. At 41, this product has helped to lessen the wrinkles on my forehead and I don't know what I would do without it!
I just started using this but so far like it. Give it time but it does show progress. I am just not a fan of the application dropper, that is my only con. I'm know that's how most serums are though.
